name: Tatama Tapaculo
rangeDescription: Pacific slope of colombian andes (western antioquia southward to southwestern valle del cauca)
description: This typical “Scytalopus” tapaculo is found only in Colombia’s western Andes. Plumage is gray with a brown tinge to the rump and faint, rusty barring on the lower underparts.

name: Tanahjampea Monarch
rangeDescription: Tanahjampea island (flores sea)
description: A striking black-and-white flycatcher-like songbird confined to Tanahjampea Island. Black above, with a black hood and upper chest and a crisp white lower breast, belly, rump, and tips to outer tail feathers.

name: Australasian Bittern
rangeDescription: Far southwestern western australia, southeastern queensland to southeastern south australia including tasmania (southwestern and southeastern australia), north, south, and stewart islands (new zealand), grande terre (new caledonia; rare) and ouvea (loyalty islands)
description: Large, stocky, strongly patterned heron with broad neck and yellow-green legs. Upperparts dark brown, underparts streaked.

name: Amami Woodcock
rangeDescription: Amami-o-shima, tokuno-shima, okinawa, tokashiki-shima (ryukyu islands, southern japan)
description: Furtive, large, ground-dwelling shorebird endemic to the broadleaf forests of northern Okinawa Island and the Amami Islands. Similar to Eurasian Woodcock but darker overall, with notably longer legs and a thicker bill base.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: Puerto Rican Oriole
rangeDescription: Puerto rico
description: A sleek inhabitant of wooded areas that ventures into gardens and parks searching for flowers and fruit; prefers areas with palms. The adult is distinctively all black except for its yellow vent, rump, and shoulders.

name: Canary Flyrobin
rangeDescription: Montane forest of new guinea
description: A small bird of montane forest interior. Olive-green upperparts, yellow underparts, black bill and orange legs.

name: Bougainville Fantail
rangeDescription: Montane forest of bougainville (northwestern solomon islands)
description: Small and drab with a long, often fanned tail. Mostly gray-brown above and slightly lighter tawny below, with a grayish head and a white eyebrow.

name: Nendo Whistler
rangeDescription: Duff, reef, and nendö (northern temotu, southeastern solomon islands)
description: Brightly-colored male has a bright golden belly, a black chest band and head, and a clean white throat. He appears to have a black “shawl” with golden wings and a black tail.

name: Sumatran Shortwing
rangeDescription: Mountains of sumatra
description: A small, dark songster of montane rainforest floor and undergrowth on Sumatra. Male is overall dark slaty-gray but slightly paler on the belly.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: Pallas's Gull
rangeDescription: South-central asia; winters mediterranean to southeastern asia
description: Large powerful gull of saline, brackish, and fresh water bodies. Breeding adult has a black head with a thin incomplete crescent around the eye and a red-and-black-tipped bill.

name: Peruvian Thick-knee
rangeDescription: Arid littoral of southwestern ecuador to southern peru; one record from northern chile
description: Distinctive, large nocturnal “shorebird” of dry desert habitats in lowlands. Note the big pale eyes, striped head, and long pale yellowish legs.

name: Banda Sea Pitta
rangeDescription: Seram, watubela, banda, tayandu, kai, and tanimbar islands
description: A typical pitta: plump, short-tailed, long-legged, and primarily terrestrial (sometimes perches up to call). Bright green above with electric blue shoulder patch and rump and black head with conspicuous pale brow.

name: White-headed Petrel
rangeDescription: Islands in southern indian ocean and southern pacific ocean
description: A large gadfly petrel with a pale white head and a distinctive dark eye-patch. Back is pale gray with darker outer wings, creating an “M” shape on the back.

name: Speckled Wood-Pigeon
rangeDescription: Montane forest of kashmir to india, west-central china, and myanmar
description: Uniquely colored large pigeon of mid- to high-altitude broadleaf and mixed forests. Grayish overall, with a deep maroon back, ashy gray head, chestnut streaking on the belly, and fine white spots on the upperwing.

name: White-bellied Imperial-Pigeon
rangeDescription: Mountains of sulawesi and sula islands (taliabu and mangole)
description: A distinctive large, spectacularly-marked pigeon. Green with a conspicuous pale gray head, a red eye-ring around a beady yellow eye, a dark neck and chest, a bold white belly, a chestnut base to the undertail, and a broad white band in the otherwise dark tail.

name: Rufous-tailed Palm-Thrush
rangeDescription: Scrub and palms of southern gabon to coastal angola and northern namibia
description: Rather plain thrush with a rufous tail, brown back, buffy throat, and red eye. Found in woodland and thickets, usually in areas with palms.

name: Sooty Shearwater
rangeDescription: Breeds southern south america, new zealand, and southeastern australia; winters to north pacific and north atlantic
description: Medium-sized, dark brown shearwater with silvery flashes on underwings. Narrow wings with quick, deep wingbeats.

name: Taita Falcon
rangeDescription: Locally in highlands of southwestern ethiopia to southwestern mozambique
description: Chunky, short-tailed falcon that shows two rufous spots on the nape when seen well. Extremely rare and localized species known from a small number of locations where it breeds on cliffs adjacent to lush habitats.

name: Obscure Berrypecker
rangeDescription: Patchily distributed in central and eastern new guinea
description: A small, rare and little-known bird of foothill forest. Medium gray head and back, pale gray throat and chest, and olive flight feathers.

name: Black-hooded Coucal
rangeDescription: Forest of mindoro (north-central philippines)
description: A large, long-tailed bird of lowland primary forest on Mindoro with a brown back and belly, dark wings with brown-edged feathers, a dark tail with a bluish iridescence, and a black hood with some light streaking on the back of the neck. Note the strong curved bill.
